title: GRINDER
subtitle: UPPER BODY AND LEGS. NO EXCUSES.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. TODAY IS GRINDER DAY. YOU WILL WORK.
script.nextExercise: NEXT EXERCISE. GET IN POSITION. NOW.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. STAY ON YOUR FEET.
script.lastSet: LAST SET. I WANT EVERYTHING YOU HAVE.
script.complete: DISMISSED. YOU SURVIVED. BARELY. SEE YOU TOMORROW.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFORTABLE.

exercises.name: PUSH-UPS
exercises.cue: CHEST TO THE DECK. LOCK OUT AT THE TOP.
exercises.speakStart: PUSH-UPS. THREE SETS OF TWELVE. CHEST TO THE DECK. ALL THE WAY UP.
exercises.speakRest: FORTY SECONDS. SHAKE THE ARMS. DO NOT LIE DOWN.

exercises.name: GOBLET SQUAT
exercises.cue: HEELS DOWN. BELL TO THE CHEST. DEPTH.
exercises.speakStart: GOBLET SQUATS. THREE SETS OF TEN. HEELS DOWN. OWN THE BOTTOM.

exercises.name: DUMBBELL ROW
exercises.cue: BACK FLAT. PULL TO THE HIP. NO SHRUG.
exercises.speakStart: ROWS. THREE SETS. TEN EACH ARM. BACK FLAT. PULL TO THE HIP.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: LONG STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. THREE SETS. EIGHT EACH LEG. CONTROL THE DROP.

exercises.name: PLANK
exercises.cue: RIBS DOWN. GLUTES ON. DO NOT SAG.
exercises.speakStart: PLANK. THREE HOLDS. FORTY SECONDS. RIBS DOWN. DO NOT SAG.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE IT OUT. BACK ON THE DECK.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HIPS LOW. DRIVE THE KNEES. FINISH HARD.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. THREE ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. HIPS LOW. FINISH HARD.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. THAT IS YOUR LAST GASP REST.
exercises.speakDone: CLIMBERS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
